# Jorge Castillo's Dev Blog

> > A comprehensive resource for mastering Jetpack Compose internals, Kotlin advanced features, and Android architecture patterns from an expert instructor and Google Developer Expert.

Jorge Castillo is a Google Developer Expert who shares deep technical knowledge about Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, and functional programming in Android development. The site features a cohort-based course, technical book, and extensive blog posts covering both foundational concepts and advanced implementation details.

## Key Topics

- Jetpack Compose
- Kotlin
- Android Development
- Compose Internals
- Functional Programming
- Material Design
- Android UI
- Composable Functions
- ConstraintLayout
- Theming
- Continuations
- Side Effects
- Online Courses
- Arrow
- Accompanist

## Core Learning Resources

- [Jetpack Compose internals 📖](https://jorgecastillo.dev/book): Technical book on Jetpack Compose internals by Jorge Castillo
- [Jetpack Compose and internals cohort course 🧑‍💻](https://jorgecastillo.dev/course): Jetpack Compose cohort-based course by Jorge Castillo
- [Hey! I am Jorge 👋](https://jorgecastillo.dev/about): Jorge Castillo's bio and professional background

## Jetpack Compose Deep Dives

- [Diving into Mosaic for Jetpack Compose](https://jorgecastillo.dev/diving-into-mosaic): Deep dive into Mosaic library and Jetpack Compose runtime
- [Composed modifiers in Jetpack Compose](https://jorgecastillo.dev/composed-modifiers-in-jetpack-compose): Guide to custom composed modifiers in Jetpack Compose
- [Jetpack Compose ViewPager](https://jorgecastillo.dev/compose-viewpager): Tutorial on Jetpack Compose pager with Accompanist library
- [Await next frame in Jetpack Compose](https://jorgecastillo.dev/jetpack-compose-await-next-frame): Frame timing and animation techniques in Jetpack Compose
- [Jetpack Compose ConstraintLayout](https://jorgecastillo.dev/jetpack-compose-constraintlayout): ConstraintLayout usage tutorial for Jetpack Compose

## Kotlin Advanced Concepts

- [Kotlin Continuations](https://jorgecastillo.dev/digging-into-kotlin-continuations): Deep dive into Kotlin continuations and CPS internals
- [Tracking side effects at compile time with suspend](https://jorgecastillo.dev/tracking-side-effects-with-suspend): Using Kotlin suspend for compile-time side effect tracking
- [Sealed interfaces in Kotlin](https://jorgecastillo.dev/sealed-interfaces-kotlin): Kotlin 1.5 sealed interfaces feature and usage guide
- [Support for Kotlin SAM in release 1.4](https://jorgecastillo.dev/kotlin-sam-conversions): Kotlin 1.4 SAM conversions and Java interoperability

## Android Architecture & Design

- [When Android met FP](https://jorgecastillo.dev/when-android-met-fp): Functional programming paradigms applied to Android development
- [Dependency Inversion on Android Theming](https://jorgecastillo.dev/dependency-inversion-on-android-theming): Architecture patterns for Android theming with Material Design
- [Putting view theming into Context](https://jorgecastillo.dev/theming-your-custom-views-through-the-context): Android view theming and Material Design best practices
- [Contrasting text and icons over background](https://jorgecastillo.dev/contrasting-text-and-icons-over-background): Color contrast and luminance calculation for Android UI

## Teaching & Professional Growth

- [Tips for productive online courses](https://jorgecastillo.dev/online-courses-tips): Instructor guide for effective online course delivery
